description.en: Devices as Docker containers (runc or gVisor runsc) behind a Docker socket proxy, with their files on volumes kept until the device is deleted: the public network is open by default, with loopback, private, link-local and metadata ranges refused, or a host allowlist
description.zh: 以 Docker 容器（runc 或 gVisor runsc）承载设备，经 Docker socket 代理访问；文件保存在卷上，直到设备被删除。网络默认开放公网（拒绝回环、私有、链路本地与元数据地址），也可用主机白名单
